D.treatment: XLM-Longformer fine-tuned for Basque and Spanish

cells.quote: It is worth mentioning here that DL models ﬁne-tuned on BasqueARA and Agrega2-Es with XLM-Longformer scored very poorly for all conﬁgurations and setups, with the best model achieving an accuracy of 30%, and were therefore discarded for further analysis.
cells.note: The supplied study text excerpt does not include the detailed comparative results against the language-specific BERT models; quote taken from the wiki entry as permitted.

D.comparison: multilingual Longformer variant and language-specific BERT models

cells.quote: The original English-only Longformer was retained, reaching 83.66-84.61% accuracy on Agrega2-En+ in the 4-level setup.
